# VALAM FOODS ISELIN NJ

VALAM FOODS is a vegetarian Indian restaurant at 224 Correja Ave, Iselin, NJ 08830.

## Food and services

- Indian and Gujarati vegetarian food
- Indian street food including pani puri, vada pav, pav bhaji and chaat
- Traditional Indian sweets including jalebi, gulab jamun, kaju katli, ladu and mohanthal
- Gujarati snacks including fafda, gathiya, khandvi and khaman dhokla
- Homestyle meals, thali and tiffin
- Chai, mango lassi and cold drinks
- Catering and party trays
